messages.subject: season as a covariate
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm currently trying to run some models and one of the covariates I wanted to introduce is seasons, but I'm having doubts on how to do it and wanted to be sure I'm thinking straight. As each of my sessions is on a specific season if I put a column with the season as a covariate on each tdf it would be similar within each tdf and just vary between tdfs. Is this a problem? Should I implement this differently? Thank you in advance.

Best regards,

Gonçalo Delgado
